# Example React Docs (full)

## memo

`memo` lets you skip re-rendering a component when its props are unchanged. Wrap your component in `memo` and React will compare the previous and next props shallowly before deciding whether rendering is needed.

## useMemo

`useMemo` is a hook that lets you cache the result of a calculation between re-renders. Pass a calculation function and a list of dependencies; React only recalculates when a dependency changes.

## Performance guide

Measure before optimising. Profile your application, find components that render too often, and only then reach for memoization techniques.
